:::{#exm-descent-directions}
#### Descent directions for $x_1^2 + x_2^2$ at $\tp{(1, 0)}$

Let $f(\vx) = x_1^2 + x_2^2$ and $\vx = \tp{(1, 0)}$, so

$$
\begin{aligned}
\vecf{g} &= \tp{(2 x_1,\ 2 x_2)} \\
&= \tp{(2, 0)}.
\end{aligned}
$$

- $\vecf{d} = \tp{(-1, 1)}$ is a descent direction:

  $$
  \begin{aligned}
  \dprod{\vecf{g}}{\vecf{d}} &= -2 + 0 \\
  &= -2 \\
  &< 0.
  \end{aligned}
  $$

- $\vecf{d} = \tp{(0, 1)}$ is not: $\dprod{\vecf{g}}{\vecf{d}} = 0$.
- $-\vecf{g} = \tp{(-2, 0)}$ is: $\dprod{\vecf{g}}{(-\vecf{g})} = -4 < 0$.

:::
